interceptors.configuration.title: Interceptors Settings
interceptors.configuration.failures.tool: Parts wearing out and failing in storms.
interceptors.configuration.failures.enab: Parts (hydraulics, tires, engine, windows, anchor computer) wear out and fail in storms.
interceptors.configuration.failures.wear: How fast parts wear in strong wind and hail. 0.5 = half as fast, 2 = twice as fast.
interceptors.configuration.failures.free: How often the anchor computer freezes in a storm. 0 turns freezing off.
interceptors.configuration.injuries.tool: What giant hail can do to players.
interceptors.configuration.injuries.hail: Giant hail can lodge in a player caught outside. It melts out by itself; pulling it out early makes it bleed.
interceptors.configuration.gore.blood.to: Show blocky pixel blood: glass cuts, hail wounds, drips and the red flash. Off = no blood at all (you still get hurt).
interceptors.configuration.stream.toolti: The LIVE overlay you toggle with B.
interceptors.configuration.stream.cleanH: While the stream overlay (B) is on, hide the hotbar, health, hunger, XP and crosshair so the capture looks clean.
interceptors.configuration.obs.tooltip: Optional link to OBS Studio's WebSocket server. Interceptors never streams by itself and never sees a stream key.
interceptors.configuration.obs.host.tool: Where OBS runs. Leave as localhost.
The OBS WebSocket server password (not your stream key!). Empty if you turned authentication off.
interceptors.configuration.obs.chopperSc: OBS scene to switch to when you open the Chopper Cam app. Empty = don't switch.
interceptors.configuration.obs.mainScene: OBS scene to switch back to when you leave the Chopper Cam app. Empty = don't switch back.
